# FRAME assemblies (source CAD, shape only)

The input to `optikit-core import assembly` for
`library/templates/openuc2.tpl.frame/assembly.yml` — see
`optikit-core/DOCS/editor/frame-assembly-contract.md`.

`FRAME #0008 - Microscope incl accessories - shape.stp` is the Inventor
export with electronics, fasteners, cables, cube inserts and most purchased
parts hidden before writing (PyInventor `export_shape_step.py`): 27.7 MB
where the full export is 269.5 MB, the same node names and poses. The
`.report.json` beside it lists every hidden occurrence and the rule that hid
it. The full export is not kept here.
